annotations.text: Proposed, matching the engine as of 14 Sep: sprites carry a tiny floating bar box top-right. No cards. Log kept in the centre. Intent chips show the action and number, not the target. Hold a unit for numbers and arrows; the eye button shows every arrow; double-tap for the codex. Round has two phases: roll (tap die to lock, hold to see every face, Reroll, Lock in) then target (drag die to spend, Undo, End turn). End turn runs the enemy and comes straight back. Numbers in tens, matching the engine. Superseded by the vector HUD board below on 14 Sep; kept for comparison.
Sketch here. Copy pieces from the parts bin, paste onto this board, drag. Rough is the point. Save when you want me to see it.

Vector HUD, ADOPTED 14 Sep and now in the engine (see the Current board): everything that is not a sprite is a flat vector overlay. Slanted gauges, chamfered dice with corner brackets when locked, bracketed [ATK 10] readouts, a terminal log above the dice, Reroll and the eye on the screen edges, End turn bottom-left and Withdraw bottom-right. The HUD colour (green, amber, red, blue) is a player setting.

In engine as of 14 Sep: log above the dice, mechs pushed to the bottom, three-quarter sprites from the procedural renderer, head-on sprite in the codex, confirmations on Withdraw and on End turn with dice unspent.
